title: Institute of Health testimonials
description: A grey band of video testimonials: a small eyebrow and a big centred three-line heading, then a sideways reel of tall portrait video cards in page-grey frames (10px corners, 6px inner video) that bleeds off the right edge. Each card has a round mute badge top-left and a name chip with a round avatar along the bottom. Under the reel, a hairline progress line fills as you scroll it and two flat square arrows step one card at a time. Phones show one card with the arrows centred.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows (hydrate: visible); swiping and the progress line work without it
video slots are dark placeholders (bg-foreground) until filled
name: instituteofhealth-testimonials
